data.name: WOLF OF THE DESERT
data.detailed_description:
Ascend the neon drenched Skyline of Cyber Arabia in this 3rd-person stealth-action thriller. Infiltrate Cyber Arabia's financial empire to find your missing brother. Master the power of 'Sand Chips' to vanish, distract, and bring down a corporate conspiracy built on illegal mining and human experimentation. In a Dystopia built on stolen dreams, you are the only hope.

AN ACTION ESPIONAGE WITH CHIPS AND CHOICE

Wolf of The Desert blends ability chip collecting and deck-building element with kinetic Vigilante Card Throwing Action and real-time immersive stealth gameplay.

A FRESH SPIN ON AN OLD GENRE

Sneak Around the Tower to collect different sand shards which can upgrade to powerful ability chips that enable different approaches, from pyro explosions to drone controlling chips, carefully craft your hand to go with the approach you want.

WHAT MAKES WOLF OF THE DESERT UNIQUE?

  • ABILITY CHIPS DETERMINE YOUR APPROACH The superpowers you strategically choose from around the level eliminate any luck factor found in other deck builder hybrids. The ability chips allow you to hack, teleport, explode, electrocute, and interact with your environment so that you can get in and out of each level like a ghost or completely obliterating any enemy in sight.

  • ACTION-ESPIONAGE LEVELS: Explore a middle eastern tower where each infiltration has to be carefully planned out and executed. You’ll ascend Qamaria tower using smoke, distraction cards and teleport cards to solve complex puzzles, hide in cover to sort your hand and stash cards, and build the ultimate hand for each scenario carefully by observing the level through enemies, drones, cameras, then collecting abilities and taking out the bosses and revealing your connection to the tower.

 OVERDRIVE HIGH-STAKES CHIP ABILITIES

In Wolf of the Desert, your Ability Chips are your greatest asset, while also being your biggest sacrifice. Trigger an Overdrive to unleash extreme, superhuman powers in an instant. But choose wisely: overdriving a chip grants you immediate dominance but destroys the chip permanently upon use. Will you save your power for the perfect getaway, or burn your deck to survive the level?

DECKBUILDING SYNERGY IN A STEALTH SANDBOX

Merging the depth of Tactical Deck-builders with the freedom of Immersive Sims, Wolf of the Desert rewards creative experimentation. Build a deck that fits your shadow-ops style:

  • The Trapper: Lure unsuspecting guards into lethal Laser Trip-mine grids.

  • The Hacker: Hack autonomous drones and force them to go rogue on their masters.

  • The Ghost: Vanish into tactical smoke clouds to reset the encounter.

Wolf of The Desert Roadmap (Dates to be Announced Soon)

📍 Phase 1:

Focus: Core Stealth Mechanics & Technical Foundation

  • Advanced AI Overhaul: Implementing Advanced AI that adapts to your playstyle, calls HQ when it sees suspicious activity, and takes frequent tea breaks.

  •  Raytraced visibility: Implementing dynamic visibility for the player based on the amount of light being shined on them.

  • Closed Alpha Playtest: Gathering feedback on the "Overdrive" chip mechanic from our core community.

📍 Phase 2:

Focus: Expanding the Deckbuilding & Synergy Systems

  • The "Dark Market" Update: 20+ new Ability Chips, Making AI Surrender when aiming at them from behind, implementing the cover system and an advanced vault system, a black market where merchants sell you tactical gear like xray vision, and Rare Cybercards

  • Dynamic 3D Crosshair: An advanced version of the 3d crosshair that adapts to your aim, locks in on important objects, and dynamically shows what effect, sound range, and distance your current chip can go.

  • Steam Next Fest Demo: A public-facing slice of the game featuring the first major compound infiltration.

📍 Phase 3:

Focus: Content Polish & Narrative Depth

  • Boss Infiltrations: Unique stealth "puzzles" where you must neutralize high-value targets without being seen.

  • Localization & Steam Deck Verification: Ensuring the "Wolf" can hunt on the go with full controller support.

data.short_description: Infiltrate Qamaria tower. Sneak through shadows, observe your surroundings. Gather ability chips to destroy and hack security devices, vanish, teleport past enemies, outsmart them using clones. Combine and upgrade ability chips for the ultimate loadout and bring down a corporate empire.
